an8.23:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā āḷaviyaṃ viharati aggāḷave cetiye.
an8.23:1.3: sattahi bhikkhave acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgataṃ hatthaṃ āḷavakaṃ dhāretha
an8.23:1.12: imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgataṃ hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ dhārethāti.
an8.23:1.14: idaṃ vatvāna sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an8.23:2.1: athakho aññataro bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena hatthakassa āḷavakassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an8.23:2.2: athakho hatthako āḷavako yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ so bhikkhu etadavoca
an8.23:3.1: sattahi kho tvaṃ āvuso acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākato
an8.23:3.10: imehi kho tvaṃ āvuso sattahi acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākatoti.
an8.23:3.11: kaccittha bhante na koci gihī ahosi odātavasanoti.
an8.23:3.12: na hettha āvuso koci gihī ahosi odātavasanoti.
an8.23:3.13: sādhu bhante yadettha na koci gihī ahosi odātavasanoti.
an8.23:4.1: athakho so bhikkhu hatthakassa āḷavakassa nivesane piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi
an8.23:4.2: athakho so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.23:5.1: idhāhaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena hatthakassa āḷavakassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃ
an8.23:5.2: athakho bhante hatthako āḷavako yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi
an8.23:5.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ etadavocaṃ
an8.23:5.4: sattahi kho tvaṃ āvuso acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākato
an8.23:5.13: imehi kho tvaṃ āvuso sattahi acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākatoti
an8.23:6.1: evaṃ vutte bhante hatthako āḷavako maṃ etadavoca
an8.23:6.2: kaccittha bhante na koci gihī ahosi odātavasanoti.
an8.23:6.3: na hettha āvuso koci gihī ahosi odātavasanoti.
an8.23:6.4: sādhu bhante yadettha na koci gihī ahosi odātavasanoti.
an8.23:7.3: sante yeva attani kusale dhamme na icchati parehi ñāyamāne
an8.23:7.4: tenahi tvaṃ bhikkhu iminā acchariyena abbhutadhammena samannāgataṃ hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ dhārehi yadidaṃ …pe… appicchatāyāti. 24
